title: Parametric reinforcement cage
description: Reusable SVG detailing-geometry component for a rectangular reinforced-concrete column cage with explicit clear cover, longitudinal-bar layout, and transverse-tie spacing.
learningObjectives: Visualize how clear cover, tie diameter, longitudinal-bar diameter, bar counts, and tie spacing determine reinforcement-cage geometry.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Candidate includes deterministic detailing geometry and reproducible spacing checks. It does not claim code compliance. Independent engineering, browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required.

source.reference: Reserved structures-agent task str-reinforcement-cage; original dependency-free SVG/DOM implementation.
